_note: V5.3 a, the regional development fund (docs/design/v5.3-ab.md 3.3 (a), src/sim/region_funds.gd). STAND-INS written by Systems so the verb can be measured; Content authors the numbers (the spec's section 10). eur_bn: the fund's range, bn a year, [lowest, highest]. years: how long it may run, whole years, [shortest, longest]. bloc_offset_per_bn: what each bn a year of a fund moves at its start, scaled by the funded region's share of the nation's population (the blocs are national, a fund is not): the region's workers and the rural vote gain, the city vote pays a little for a transfer it does not receive.
